etsy.title: Baseball Senior Night Gift | Custom Poster & Trading Card Set | Printed or Digital
etsy.description:
One last home game on the diamond. Four years of practices, bus rides and doubleheaders — and one night to honor all of it. This is the senior night gift that outlasts the flowers: a personalized baseball poster and trading-card set built from your own photos of your senior, in a gold SENIOR NIGHT edition made for the occasion.

THE SENIOR NIGHT EDITION

• Champagne-gold ceremony style: the arena, the confetti, the spotlight — their last home game, made forever
• CLASS OF 2026 lockup and career years (FR–SR) on the poster
• The card back carries their 4-YEAR CAREER — freshman to senior — plus their senior quote, an athlete signature line, and a numbered SENIOR EDITION 1 OF 1 stamp

WHAT YOU GET — 28 FILES IN EVERY PACKAGE

POSTER
• 18x24 in poster file, print-ready 300 DPI

CARDS
• Card FRONT and BACK, print-ready 300 DPI, 2.48 x 3.46 in (63 x 88 mm)
• A signed certificate of authenticity with their class year
• A vertical card-flip video for sharing

SOCIAL & SCREENS
• 9 social media files (grid posts, stories, reel cover, profile picture, cover banner)
• 7 wallpapers for phone, tablet and desktop

PROVENANCE
• Your senior's card gets its own live web page with a QR code — scan it, it opens

BONUS
• A die-cut name-and-number sticker, a number badge, and four transparent cutouts of your athlete

BUILT FOR BASEBALL

This listing is built for BASEBALL. Other sports have their own Senior Night sets in our shop, and the any-sport Senior Night set covers all 17.

SENIOR NIGHT IS ON THE CALENDAR

Senior night has a date, and it doesn't move. Order with your photos ready and we send the reference for your approval first — you see your senior before anything is finished. Digital sets arrive through Etsy in 1–2 days; printed sets ship free with tracking.

CHOOSE YOUR PACKAGE

DIGITAL COMPLETE SET — all 28 files + the live registry page. Ready in 1–2 days. Print at home, a local print shop or online.
PRINTED SET — 12 printed cards, square-cut, + an 18x24 printed poster + a printed certificate, plus every file. Ships free, tracked, in 5–7 days.
DELUXE SET — 24 printed cards + a 24x36 printed poster + a printed certificate, plus every file. Ships free, tracked, in 5–7 days.
ULTIMATE SET — the Deluxe Set plus a SEALED FOIL PACK of 18 cards (4 holographic chase cards + 14 standard). Ships in three tracked packages: cards in about a week, the poster in about a week and a half, the sealed pack in about three weeks.

FREE CERTIFICATE

Every package carries a signed certificate of authenticity with the card ID, the class year and the edition stamp — as a file in the digital set, printed in every printed set.

OUR PROMISE

You approve the reference before anything is finished. If the likeness is not right, we fix it before we print. Printed items that arrive damaged are reprinted free.

SHIPPING

Printed sets ship free within the US with tracking from our US print lab. Digital sets do not ship — the files arrive in your Etsy messages.

HOW YOUR SET IS MADE — OUR 6-STEP PROCESS

Your athlete is not a photo dropped into a template. We build a new image of them.

1 · PHOTO CHECK. We review the photos you send and tell you straight away if anything won't work.
2 · KIT BUILD. We reconstruct the uniform, club crest and colours for your sport.
3 · REFERENCE PLATE. We create and lock one reference of your athlete — face, build, hair, kit. You approve it before we go on.
4 · THE SHOTS. Every pose inherits that locked reference, so all of them are the same person.
5 · VERIFICATION. We measure the face match numerically and check every mark on the kit against the reference.
6 · FINISH. The approved frames are composed into the poster, cards and files.

ORDERING FOR THE WHOLE SENIOR CLASS

Senior night honors every senior at once. Send us the roster and we build a set for each of them — the same edition, each with their own name, number and career. They are delivered together as one order. Message us with how many seniors you have before you buy and we will set it up.

HOW TO ORDER

1. Choose the sport above — SENIOR NIGHT gold is the edition, so there is no art-style picker on this listing
2. Add your senior's name, number, team, class year — and their senior quote if you'd like it on the card back
3. Upload 4-10 photos
4. We send the reference for approval before anything else is made
5. Digital sets arrive through Etsy; printed sets ship to your door with tracking

PHOTOS THAT WORK BEST

• 4 to 10 photos, the more the better
• High resolution — not blurry when you zoom in
• Face clearly visible, good light, no heavy filters
• At least one full-body photo, head to feet
• If possible, one in the team's kit
• Team crest or logo as a separate image if you have it

AI DISCLOSURE

These images are created with AI image tools, directed by our own prompts and our own six-step process. Every frame is reviewed, corrected and approved by a human before anything is delivered. Results depend on the photos you send.

GOOD TO KNOW

• We never reproduce real league or brand marks (NFL, FIFA, NCAA, Olympic, or sportswear logos). Your school or club's own crest, yes — a licensed league mark, never.
• Your photos are used for your order only and are deleted on request.
